text:
nora: Heads-up -- a few new hires in APAC/EMEA are reporting the orientation event shows the wrong local time in Outlook/iOS calendars. Can someone check the event timezone and attachments?

ben: Looking now. The event creator accidentally left it as 'Floating' in Google Calendar which sometimes lands as UTC in Exchange/Outlook. We're actually running at 10:00 PT (America/Los_Angeles).

anya: I'll recreate the event with explicit TZ set to America/Los_Angeles and upload a fresh .ics. Also planning to paste the canonical start time in the description using ISO so clients that ignore TZ still see the correct wall clock: 2026-11-15T10:00:00-08:00 (PT).

sylvia: Good. For Outlook on Windows the "floating" vs explicit TZ behavior is a common gotcha. Can we add a short troubleshooting blurb for users: "If your calendar still shows a different time, check device timezone, calendar account settings (Exchange/O365), or add the event manually via the attached ICS."

nora: Yes please. And include the raw join URL (no query params) and passcode in the body too. Mobile clients sometimes strip ?pwd=... from the j/ link.

anya: Added the snippet to the description and the event body now contains:

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/1122334455?pwd=onboard2026
Passcode: Onboard!26
Fallback: https://zoom.us/w/1122334455
Start (PT ISO): 2026-11-15T10:00:00-08:00

ben: Also note for DST transitions some desktop clients display the converted hour with the wrong offset if the calendar system hasn't synced tz rules. Might be worth adding "Start (PT)" explicitly like you did.

ops: On the recording side: onboarding-bot will capture the session and upload to s3://redwood-onboarding/meetings. We'll post a share link to #new-hires and pin it. Default retention for orientation recordings is 120 days unless compliance requests otherwise. (automated message)

onboarding-bot: Recording will be uploaded to s3://redwood-onboarding/meetings and a link posted to #new-hires within 30 minutes after the session. Retention: 120 days.

sylvia: Nice. Could we also ask hosts to put the raw URL on slide 1 and paste it in chat at start? Saves people from digging in calendar descriptions.

anya: Added host checklist to the event notes: "1) Put raw join URL on slide 1; 2) paste join URL in chat; 3) attach recording to event after upload; 4) add chapter timestamps."

nora: I'll DM folks in APAC and EMEA with the PT start time and a one-line suggestion: check device timezone & re-add the ICS manually if needed.

ben: One more: for contractors using Apple Calendar, sometimes the native client shows the organizer's locale. If anyone reports that, ask them to toggle "Time Zone Support" in Calendar settings.

anya: Good point. I added a short troubleshooting FAQ in the event description covering Outlook/Exchange, Apple Calendar Time Zone Support, and how to add the ICS manually.

ops: If you want, we can also create a calendar event in the company shared calendar (which tends to propagate correctly to Exchange accounts) and invite the new hires from there.

nora: Let's do that as a fallback. Can you create the shared-calendar invite and cc me?

ops: Will do in ~5 mins and will post confirmation here.

onboarding-bot: Shared calendar invite created and sent. Link will be pinned to this thread once delivery confirmed.

nora: Thanks everyone. If anyone still sees weird times after the shared invite, reply here and we'll send individualized invites. :raised_hands:
